title: UNZA 2025/26 CSC 4792 — Siavonga Town Council Dataset
description: Curated machine-readable data repository capturing public financial disclosures, Constituency Development Fund (CDF) allocations under Act No. 76 of 2026 (K40M ceiling), Zambia Devolution Support Programme (ZDSP) infrastructure projects, and administrative records for Siavonga Town Council, Southern Province, Zambia.
